{{Quote|Such Jedi dedicate themselves to the healing arts of the Force, and ways to defend the innocent. But, they must also defend themselves. A Jedi Sage can confuse an opponent's mind, or use telekinesis to stop him in his tracks.|Dynaroth|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Jedi Sages''' were [[Jedi Consular]]s who fought for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] that followed it circa [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="Holonet-Jedi Consular">{{Holonet|classes|jedi-consular|Jedi Consular}}</ref> Jedi Sages were still part of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] through the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].

==Overview==
[[File:JediSage-TOR.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A Jedi Sage during the Great Galactic War]]
These [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] specialized in [[Force healing/Legends|Force healing]] and [[Telekinesis/Legends|Telekinesis]]. Jedi Sages were known to primarily wield one single-bladed lightsaber in combat, and were adept at [[Telekinesis/Legends#Applications_of_telekinesis_deriving_from_uses_of_Force_Push|ranged attacks]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="FanFriday">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20100820-0|text=STAR WARS: The Old Republic Fan Friday (August 20, 2010)|nolive=1}}</ref> They were also expert trackers, being able to find numerous people across the galaxy through deep meditation.

The use of the term "Jedi Sage" to denote specialized Jedi Consulars may have been an adaptation of the term "Sage Master", which was previously used to denote a Jedi Consular of great skill and learning.<ref name="TJP" /> The term [[Sage Master/Legends|Sage Master]] was used to describe the subjects of two [[Bronzium/Legends|Bronzium]] statues at the main entrance of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] memorializing two of the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] who founded the temple circa [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]].<ref name="Star Wars: Complete Locations 2005">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi Sage is an advanced class specialization for the [[Jedi Consular]] class in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. This advanced class specializes in the use of Force healing and telekinesis in battle. The [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] counterpart for this archetype is the Sith Sorcerer specialization for the [[Sith Inquisitor]] class.<ref name="FanFriday" />

The Jedi Sage was originally announced as the "Jedi Wizard." However, after fans voiced their distaste for the name BioWare posted a user poll on the ''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' forums to allow registered users to select a new name for the advanced class.<ref name="TORweb-Vote for the Jedi Consular Advanced Class">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20101105-0|text=Vote for the Jedi Consular Advanced Class|nolive=1}}</ref> The voting options for the poll were ''Jedi Sage'', ''Jedi Seer'', ''Jedi Adept'', and ''Jedi Wizard''. Jedi Sage won the poll with 15,251 votes. Jedi Wizard came last with 1,102 votes.<ref>{{TORweb|url=community/showthread.php?t=221713|text=Surveys and Polls - Vote for the Jedi Consular Advanced Class}}</ref> The name of the advanced class was officially changed to Jedi Sage on [[December 2]], [[2010]].<ref name="TORweb-Jedi Wizard Renamed">{{TORweb|url=news/news-article/20101203|text=Jedi Wizard Renamed|nolive=1}}</ref>
